headline: LAD @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.26 at ARI 3.36, with a projected total of 7.62. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: LAD moved -0.65 runs while ARI moved -0.20, changing the projected margin by -0.44 runs. The projected total fell -0.85, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Shohei Ohtani, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tim Tawa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
